Hi Adam,

Thanks for chasing this, and sorry you had to. Here is exactly where it stands.

Your BS-2 from order Shop···· was checked by Hal on October 30 and confirmed faulty on the unit itself, not the power supply. The return then went to our team for approval, and that approval has not come through yet. That is on us, not on you, and it is the reason no email has reached you since Friday.

I have put it in front of the team this morning and a colleague is picking it up today. Once it is approved I will send you the prepaid return label and the reference to write on the outside of the box, and I will set up the replacement BS-2 at no charge so it is reserved for you. The replacement ships once your faulty unit reaches our warehouse.

Nothing you need to do right now beyond keeping the BS-2 and its original box to hand.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Adam,

You're welcome. Nothing further needed from you for now.

A colleague is picking the approval up today, and as soon as it clears I will come back to you here with the prepaid return label and the reference to write on the box, plus the details of the replacement BS-2.

Just keep the unit and its original box to hand in the meantime.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Adam,

Sorry, you shouldn't have to chase this. Here is the honest position.

The fault on your BS-2 was confirmed on October 30, but the return approval still hasn't been signed off on our side, and until it is I can't generate your prepaid label or release the replacement. That delay is ours.

I have pushed it again with the people who sign it off, and someone is picking your ticket up to get it approved. As soon as it clears, you get the prepaid return label and the reference to write on the box, and the replacement BS-2 is set aside for you at no charge, shipping once your faulty unit reaches our warehouse. You will hear it from me in this thread, you don't need to chase again.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
